content.short: OpenZeppelin Defender reduces risk as you deploy smart contracts through a SecOps toolchain.
content.description: OpenZeppelin Defender is a security toolset designed to enforce best practices when deploying and maintaining smart contracts across multiple chains. It enables users to monitor contracts and automatically trigger actions if a vulnerability or incident is detected. Developers can write scripts to automate smart-contract execution and assemble maintenance pipelines that include embedded vaults, meta-transactions, and centralized API key management, streamlining governance and protection.
content.meta: OpenZeppelin Defender helps manage and secure smart contracts across chains. Discover OpenZeppelin Defender and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
